claim: Simon Green: OU connection first, then the official citation, which stays as written.

suggestion.to: A main-belt asteroid named after Richard Greenwood, a senior research fellow at the Open University. Its official naming citation reads: “Richard Greenwood (b. 1957) is an English senior research fellow at The Open University who specializes in using oxygen isotopic analyses of extraterrestrial material to understand the origin and early evolution of the Solar System. He has also written a book on meteorites that was geared towards a general audience.” The shape model of this object is awaiting further study - and it may or may not be accurately represented in this visualisation.
